title: The Evacuee Exodus
logline: A colonial delegate discovers a planetary radiation evacuation order was faked across three star systems so a mining conglomerate can seize empty orbital habitats without paying relocation costs.

roles.description: Leads a convoy of twenty thousand displaced miners crammed aboard unshielded freight lighters; desperate, watchful, demanding proof.
An independent solar astrophysicist who discovered the solar flare warning was manufactured using altered telemetry.
A heavy corporate cruiser enforcing quarantine lanes to prevent evacuated residents from returning home.
Thousands of evicted orbital families displaced from their moon habitats and crowded into transit holding bays.
The extraction holding company that stands to acquire vacant orbital real estate once the evacuation is declared permanent.
The evacuated lunar orbital station in the home system, its residential rings dark and silent.
A deep-space solar telescope platform in an adjacent system that monitors stellar flare cycles.
An overcrowded refugee receiving platform two jumps away where displaced families face starvation and disease.

public_situation: Twenty thousand citizens are evacuated across three systems after {role:mineral_conglomerate} announces imminent catastrophic solar coronal ejections.
private_truth: {role:provincial_surveyor} discovered the solar flare warning was entirely fabricated by the conglomerate to clear the mineral-rich moon for automated strip-mining.

beats.public_change: Sirens wail as civilian families are herded onto un-provisioned bulk ore barges while corporate security seals the habitat airlocks.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to slip past corporate patrols and recover the surveyor's raw solar sensor log drive from the sealed observatory deck.
missions.private_fact: Her younger brother was arrested as a 'panic-monger' when he questioned the evacuation timing at the primary docks.

beats.public_change: Corporate patrols in the neighboring system order all civilian vessels away from solar observatory relays under threat of impoundment.

missions.reason: She requires a fast courier to enter the neighboring sector and sample sensor arrays along the solar corona, proving the flare cycle remains entirely placid.
missions.private_fact: {role:provincial_surveyor} is currently in hiding inside the telescope's maintenance pod, subsisting on emergency nutrient paste.

beats.public_change: Corporate hunter packs intercept the refugee barge communication channels, transmitting virus payloads to disable navigation beacons.

missions.reason: She needs the corporate interceptors destroyed before their jamming arrays cause the overloaded refugee barges to collide in transit.
missions.private_fact: The refugee barges have less than twenty-four hours of breathable air remaining in their unventilated holds.

beats.public_change: The refugee convoy stalls outside the border gate as sanitation systems fail and drinking water runs out.

missions.reason: She needs industrial water purification filters purchased from open commercial ports and brought to the sanctuary dock to keep the refugees alive.
missions.private_fact: She sold her family's ancestral land allotment deed to a scrapper broker to pay for the filters.

beats.public_change: {role:interdictor_frigate} blocks the return hyperlane, broadcasting that the home system is an unapproachable dead zone.

missions.reason: She needs the corporate cruiser disabled so the truth of the fake emergency can be broadcast to the entire sector and the refugees can turn back.
missions.private_fact: The cruiser commander hails mid-combat offering lifetime mineral royalties from the seized moon if the pilot turns over the solar data.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot disables the frigate and exposes the fake solar emergency.
resolutions.summary: The solar emergency is proven a fraud. Twenty thousand refugees turn their ships around and reclaim their habitats, breaking {role:mineral_conglomerate}'s land grab.

consequences.public_summary: A mercenary exposed a fabricated solar flare panic and guided twenty thousand displaced miners back to their homes.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the corporate royalty deal and buries the solar survey.
resolutions.summary: The solar emergency is cemented in law. {role:mineral_conglomerate} takes title to the abandoned lunar habitats, and the refugees are scattered across distant squatter ports.

consequences.public_summary: Dark rumors tell of a pilot who took mining shares to help corporate landlords steal an entire moon under a fake radiation alarm.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or abandons the convoy.
resolutions.summary: Without verified solar proof, the evacuation becomes permanent. Overcrowding and famine decimate the refugee convoys, while automated strip-mining begins on the moon.

loose_threads.detail: Automated drill rigs arriving at the moon bear shipping manifests dated two weeks before the flare warning was issued.
The regional banking exchange shows corporate options shorting municipal habitat bonds thirty-six hours before the evacuation order.
The solar warning advisory posted at the gates bears an electronic signature hash copied from a century-old flare record in another system.

radio_hooks: Provincial authorities declare total evacuation of lunar orbital sectors citing solar radiation.
Refugee convoys face critical water and medical shortages across intermediate transit platforms.
{role:mineral_conglomerate} announces emergency deployment of automated infrastructure to 'protect assets'.

voice_direction.evacuation_delegate: Gravelly, hurried, and fierce. Speaks with the desperate authority of someone keeping twenty thousand panicking people from mutiny while checking life-support gauges.
voice_direction.provincial_surveyor: Furtive, rapid, and terrified. Uses hushed, conspiratorial cadences, delivering astrophysics equations in panicked bursts.
